props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while
keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the checkbox when it is initially rendered. Use when you do not need to control its value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the checkbox

props.name: falseValue
props.description: The value used when the checkbox is unchecked. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The controlled value of the checkbox. Can be bound with v-model.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the field. Submitted with its owning form as part of a name/value pair.

props.name: required
props.description: When `true`, indicates that the user must set the value before the owning form can be submitted.

props.name: trueValue
props.description: The value used when the checkbox is checked. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: value
props.description: The value given as data when submitted with a `name`.
